title: Tabaxkatu bariyer yi
intro: Ci biir réew yu yaatu, la nit ku am doole dem tukki yu bari, ñu jox ko kiliftéef ak jumtukaay yu bari. Ruuh googu daje na ak nit ñu bari te wuute, jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu amul fenn, bàyyi fa lim bu nara yàgg ci taarix ak ngëm jaaraleko ci seeni jëf ak seen xam-xam, boole ci xam fu seen doole bawoo dëgg.
clues: Dañu ma jox kàttan ak kàttan ci lépp, ma topp benn yoon.
Sama tukki yóbbu ma ci barab bi jant bi di so, foofu laa daje ak askan.
Daje naa ak nit ñu bari ñu mënul dégg kàddu, ñu dëkk ci diggante ñaari tundu.
Dañu ma sant ma tabax benn bariyer, te du ngir sama bopp, waaye ngir mu aar ma ci dooley yàq.
Ma wax ni dooley tabax miir bu rëy bii mingi joge ci Yàlla, te dina taxaw ba jamono ji mu ko digoon.
Sama tur, ñu koy faral di tekki 'Ki Am Ñaari Bejj,' dafay tekki sama yegg ci àdduna bi wala amaana ñaari jamono yu wuute.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Tabax ab bariyeer bu am doole
trial.answer: Tabax ab bariyeer bu am doole

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
